summary: M4 step 3 appends invalidations[] to a git-COMMITTED record from inside a workflow run, leaving an uncommitted worktree edit; commit discipline is unspecified
evidence: M4 evaluation step 3 ('decision-invalidated') appends {atMs, generationId, mismatchedFields, priorValue, currentValue} to milestones/prepare-decisions/<taskId>.json — a committed artifact modeled on milestones/prepare-telemetry/ — during an autonomous workflow run, then proceeds. The Proposal calls this 'a git-diffable evidence edit, never a disappearing log line' but never states who/when commits the append; a needs-human flow that never reaches a Land commit would leave the edit dirty (or lost on worktree cleanup). Risk is bounded: the append is audit-only (the live outcome 'proceed as no-decision-on-file' does not depend on it) and re-derivation on a fresh clone re-appends idempotently on the next scope-mismatched generation.
